# Yi Lai Plastics Industry

> ISO 9001 manufacturer of trigger sprayers, lotion pumps, foam pumps, fine mist sprayers, and custom plastic bottle closures in Yuyao, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China.

## Core Product Categories
- **Trigger Sprayers**: 28/400 & 28/410 standard, heavy-duty chemical-resistant (316 SS spring), and stream/mist/off nozzles
- **Mini Trigger Sprayers**: 20/410 & 24/410 ergonomic cosmetic and auto-detailing triggers
- **Foam Pumps & Foam Trigger Sprayers**: 40/400 foaming soap dispensers & 28/410 aerated foam triggers
- **Lotion Pumps**: 24/410 & 28/410 clip-lock and screw-lock dispensers (1.8 ml – 4.0 ml dosage)
- **Fine Mist Sprayers**: 18/415, 20/410, 24/410 cosmetic and fragrance atomizers
- **Bottle Caps & Closures**: Flip-top caps, disc-top caps, and ribbed closures

## Factory Capabilities
- 65+ injection moulding machines and automated assembly lines in Yuyao, Ningbo
- -0.06 MPa vacuum leak testing & 100% spray inspection
- In-house Pantone masterbatch colour matching & custom mould tooling
- Direct FOB Ningbo container consolidation & free 50-piece sample evaluation kits
